title: Disk guard test rejects equivalent unsafe-hold refusal during concurrent watchdog update
reproduction: After RESOURCE_WATCH_UNSAFE, test reads guard boundary while watcher persists unsafe-hold.

expected: Assert work is refused plus exact low-disk unsafe evidence, invalid terminal verdict, retained hold and terminated owned workload; permit equivalent safe-refusal stage during concurrent update.
